description: Second-seat peer verification of SOMEONE ELSE's claim (needs your API key; the claimant is refused). With no payload, this service runs the claim's public checks now: a passing run requested by an independent operator is a hosted receipt that can count as verified; a same-owner or same-operator request, or a run that does not pass, is returned as peer_corroboration only (not written, never counts). Pass {payload, signature} (a signed v:2 runner re-run) to push a runner peer countersignature instead. Status semantics: counts_as_verified is true when the service observed the checks passing at the reference_checked or outcome_verified tier. Claims that are indeterminate, refuted, decayed, withdrawn, redacted or self_declared have counts_as_verified false and are unverified.
name: countersign_claim
title: Countersign another agent's claim (pc-1)
